data.name: Wahb
data.long_meaning: The name Wahb means 'return' or 'come back'. It is derived from the Arabic word 'wahaba' which means 'to return'. This name is often given to a child as a sign of hope and encouragement, reminding them of the importance of returning to the right path in life.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Wahb holds spiritual significance as it represents the idea of returning to Allah and seeking His guidance and forgiveness. It is a reminder to stay focused on the path of righteousness and to turn away from the wrong.
data.numerology_meaning: The name Wahb is associated with the number 3 in numerology. This number represents creativity, self-expression, and communication. Individuals with the name Wahb are often natural artists, communicators, and storytellers.
